ops.text: (c) TRANSITION ASSISTANCE AND RETURN OF LICENSEE DATA. Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Licensor shall (i) at Licensee's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for a period of up to six (6) months at Licensor's then-current rates; (ii) within thirty (30) days of Licensee's request, return to Licensee all Licensee data, trade records and other information relating to Licensee or its customers that is held in or generated through the Licensed Technology, in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (iii) thereafter delete such data from its systems and certify such deletion to Licensee in writing. Licensor shall not delete or withhold access to such data prior to completing the return described in clause (ii).

input.comment: [Playbook] We added an orderly exit: Licensor returns our data in a machine-readable format within 30 days, provides up to six months of transition assistance at its then-current rates, and only then deletes and certifies deletion. Article XXI currently only requires us to return Licensor's materials and is silent on our own data, which we cannot accept on a hosted trading platform.
input.summary: Insert transition assistance and data-return obligation into Article XXI (Effect of Termination).
